about: V3's first live zone (Strategy's live-zone brief, phase 1), in the shape of V1's origins/zone-rows/zone7.row.json cut to what one player in one zone needs. Positions are metres in the zone's own frame (V1's: x east, z south; the same frame as the yard and pit below). `respawn`: where a dead hero stands again at full health after `downSeconds` of `died` (the 'You died' beat, V1 main.ts:1030). `areas`: rectangles (V1 safeAreas): `pvp` is the area's own flag, `spawnsAllowed` false keeps every spawn row out of it. `spawns`: one row per creature camp; `kind` is an opponent profile id (today the opponent data/fight.json names; the difficulty profile rows replace it later); `respawnSeconds` is V1 spawn rows' own field; `roster` says the creature appears in the zone's roster listing; `behaviour`: aggro and leash are metres, roam is metres per second of wander, campSize is [min, max] creatures per camp (capped by src/fight/world-rules-defs.json campMax at spawn). The default zone id is data/zones/index.json. Validated by src/sim/validate.js validateZone; read by src/zone/zone-rows.ts only.
name: The Yard
